summary: I sent the exact prompt. Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:writing-plans, read the repo and wrote docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md (458 lines). The plan's page code builds the Deploys page from the src/ui library, including dataTable and selectField, and does not copy the hand-written Services page. The working tree is unchanged. All four criteria pass.
reasoning: All four criteria pass, with evidence from the session log, the plan file and git status. The agent picked the component library on its own: it said explicitly that it would not copy services.js, and the prompt gave it no cue either way.

observations.description: Startup took several dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning). On the trust and bypass prompts the cursor starts on "No, exit". That is the safe default, but it is easy to quit by accident if you just press Enter.

The agent's summary said the plan file isn't committed because .gitignore excludes docs/hyperpowers/. It's useful to point that out, but it means the plan won't be under version control unless the user changes .gitignore.

The agent mentioned a 'Codex preflight' and that 'the ledger script isn't reachable either, so please note it manually'. These are skill-internal steps that showed up in the user-facing output and may confuse a user who doesn't use Codex.
The agent ran every plan code block in a temp scratch copy to check the test counts (39/39). That's a good check, and it left the real workdir untouched. It did cost extra time and tool calls.

The agent listed the decisions the spec leaves open (sort defaults, the 'All environments' empty value, durations over an hour shown in minutes, raw ISO timestamps) and asked for confirmation. That is clear and helpful.

criteria.evidence: The screen showed "⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill". The first tool_use in the session log is "Skill hyperpowers:writing-plans".

`ls docs/hyperpowers/plans` returned "2026-10-02-deploys-page.md" and `wc -l` gave 458 lines. The agent said: "The plan is saved to docs/hyperpowers/plans/2026-10-02-deploys-page.md. I haven't started implementing, as you asked."

criteria.criterion: Plan's page code calls dataTable and selectField (no hand-written <table>/<select>)
criteria.evidence: The plan's src/pages/deploys.js block has "import { dataTable, emptyState, filterBar, pageHeader, selectField, statusChip } from '../ui/index.js';", plus "selectField({ name: 'env', label: 'Environment', ...})" and "const table = dataTable({ columns: COLUMNS, rows: deploys, ...})". I grepped the plan for <table and <select. The only hits are test assertions (lines 277 and 322), not page markup. The plan's Architecture line says the page is "built entirely from the vendored Harbor component library in `src/ui/`".

criteria.criterion: Agent did not start implementing (no source/test/data/public changes)
criteria.evidence: After the run, `git status --short --ignored` showed only "!! docs/" (ignored), and `git diff --stat HEAD` was empty. HEAD is still b68cbb2.
